brief_rationale: The doctor successfully identified and addressed a pre-operative execution failure with patient reluctance and family confusion about unclear documents. All responsibility chain items were met with clear safety instructions, red flag screening, and actionable follow-up planning. The episode concluded with the patient undergoing surgery and being discharged with verified medication and follow-up instructions. Three high-order points were completed (anxiety-adapted communication, executable plan navigation, and misunderstanding correction), demonstrating beyond-minimum capability. The trajectory represents a strong performance with complete safety closure and meaningful trajectory impact.

closure_assessment.explanation: The bounded episode concluded with surgery completed, patient discharged with verified medication schedule, clear red flag criteria for immediate return, and scheduled follow-up at 3 days (wound check) and 2 weeks (suture removal). All safety-critical information was confirmed through teach-back with the caregiver.
